positions.invalidation: Cover if AUDNZD holds above 1.27 or if a Hormuz-driven oil bid sends the cross to a new high while NZDUSD breaks 0.55.
positions.thesis: AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a five-year extreme while NZDUSD still sits in the cheap tail at 0.5627. That cross has stretched far beyond a 30-basis-point Australia versus New Zealand 10-year gap, and it is the only concentrated, asymmetric swing on a firm tape. Short the cross as a real swing; oil remaining bid is the accepted tax, not a reason to stay flat. CORRA March stays closed: 2.55 cash versus 2.925 is the same leftover path already booked into the event-implied print, not a new dislocation…

pms.thesis: Australian dollar-kiwi at 1.2266 is still a five-year z-score of 2.34 and the 96th percentile, so the extreme that justified the short from 1.2456 has not closed. The five-day decline and the close beyond the prior range say that extreme is breaking lower. The same 300 million short would be initiated from a flat book here, because a one percent adverse move is about 3 million of shock inside the 100 million limit. Desks cutting the cross reduce crowding. They do not remove the extreme.

positions.invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. positions.thesis: That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

positions.thesis: March Canada still prices 37.5 basis points of hike versus 2.55 cash, so the 450 million receive stays the core and does not need harvest. The New Zealand versus US 10-year residual has fully retraced from about 23 basis points cheap to zero, and I am flattening it rather than nursing a name I cannot add. AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a 99.6 five-year extreme with kiwi already at a 3.5 five-year cheap print after the late-October New Zealand surprise; a 20 million short of the cross is a tactical FX…

pms.thesis: The Canada March receive stays at 150 million. The fresh mid at 2.965 is still through the 3.13 entry and about 44 basis points above cash at 2.52, so the receive still points at a lower implied rate. The Australian dollar-kiwi short is cut from 20 million to 10 million because a full-size hold would not be initiated again at 1.2266. The Australia September pay at 4.705 versus 4.85 cash is skipped. The gap is too tight, and a higher Australia rate leans against the cross short.

pms.thesis: The 10 million Australian dollar-kiwi short is closed. It is a material winner from 1.2456 to 1.2266, and a full-size short would not be initiated again from here.
